tasks.short: Direct technical aspects of newscasts and productions and own the on-air product.

steps.what: Read the current newscast rundown and retrieve source, camera and graphics references
inputs: current producer rundown
source assignments and graphics list
outputs: checked technical rundown references

steps.what: Check actual video sources, camera shots and graphics on preview monitors and identify faults or late changes
inputs: checked technical rundown references
actual live preview sources
outputs: verified current preview state and faults

steps.what: Direct technical production with the crew and choose the next shot, source and graphics combination
inputs: verified current preview state and faults
producer's current editorial cues
outputs: ready preview composition and intended transition cue

steps.what: Confirm the actual finished preview composition, graphics, selected source and immediate on-air take cue
inputs: ready preview composition and intended transition cue
outputs: approved current preview and take cue

steps.what: Manually switch the approved current preview source and graphics to the on-air output at the confirmed cue
inputs: approved current preview and take cue
outputs: actual transmitted source and graphics state

steps.what: Prepare an actual production exception note with source, time, fault and response details
inputs: actual transmitted source and graphics state
actual observed faults and crew responses
outputs: complete technical exception note

steps.what: Approve the completed actual technical exception note and its internal record destination
inputs: complete technical exception note
outputs: approved technical note version

steps.what: Commit the approved exception note to internal production records
inputs: approved technical note version
outputs: versioned production exception note

tasks.design: Configure native rundown references in {OTHER}, the station newsroom rundown, preview monitor and vision mixer systems. Source checks, crew direction, shot choices and manual on-air takes remain full human work. Each repeated cue passes from an actual finished preview to immediate confirmation and a separate external take; a changed preview, source or timing requires fresh confirmation. A separately captured actual exception note in {DOCS} is approved before an internal commit. No model or autonomous live switching is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rundown references and post-production filing add handling around live direction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rundown links and controlled document filing can reduce that handling.
tasks.still_hard: Unpredictable live sources, timing and editorial consequences.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for what actually reaches the audience.

ambition.what: Reduce reference and record handling around live direction.

tasks.altitude: Live broadcast control remains with the technical director.

reach.learn: Confirm the actual preview state immediately before each take.

evidence.claim: Rundown systems can link source references and native document workflows can file approved technical records.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured. s2-s5 describe repeated cue cycles, with aggregated human time, not a blanket approval of a future programme.

s1 includes checking rundown version, source ID, shot assignment and graphics reference and manual lookup where links fail. s6 manually captures actual time, fault, affected source and response; no complete as-run note is assumed.

Actual switch operation retains full time; machine playout duration is not labour. Generic on-air source selection is owned here; specialized effects execution, if combined with task 3905, must be allocated once in a roll-up.
unknowns: Rundown linking coverage and actual exception-record practice.
research_questions: Can native references save time without adding live distraction?

already_counted.description: Actual exception capture and final record review.

incremental.description: Maintain source reference links and note fields.

approvals.approved_version: actual current preview composition, source, graphics and immediate take cue; any change requires renewed confirmation
exact completed actual exception note and internal record destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: three rundown-retrieval hours saved less one upkeep. Low: existing native retrieval leaves upkeep only. Same-production-record commitment and live operation retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set up and execute video transitions and special effects.

steps.what: Check the production brief and capture exact fades, dissolves, cuts, keys, supers and source requirements
inputs: actual production effects brief
actual source pictures and technical formats
outputs: checked effects requirements and source IDs

steps.what: Set up transitions and special effects with native presets, key parameters and reusable supers layouts
inputs: checked effects requirements and source IDs
outputs: complete proposed effect configuration and preview

steps.what: Test the actual configured transitions, picture manipulation and effects for timing, key edges, legibility and source compatibility
inputs: complete proposed effect configuration and preview
outputs: tested final effect configuration and execution target

steps.what: Approve the actual tested final effect configuration, sources and internal execution destination
inputs: tested final effect configuration and execution target
outputs: approved effect execution version

steps.what: Execute the approved transitions and effects to the isolated recorded-production output and inspect the actual result
inputs: approved effect execution version
outputs: actual rendered effect clip and execution metadata

steps.what: Approve the actual rendered effect clip, version metadata and controlled archive location
inputs: actual rendered effect clip and execution metadata
outputs: approved effect archive version

steps.what: Commit the approved effect clip and configuration metadata to the internal production archive
inputs: approved effect archive version
outputs: versioned internal effects asset

tasks.design: Configure existing transitions, keyers, supers templates and batch controls in {OTHER}, the production switcher or video effects editor, before custom code. {DOCS} holds the brief. This graph covers effects for recorded production on an isolated output. Human parameter selection and visual testing remain; reusable presets reduce repeated setup and native queued controls reduce repeated operator actions. Approval follows the final tested configuration before execution. Actual output then receives separate archive approval and commit. Changes void approval. No generative model or public on-air take is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated effect parameters and layouts require operator setup and repeated execution controls.
tasks.enabler_now: Native effect presets, reusable compositions and queued execution controls.
tasks.still_hard: Visual quality, keys on difficult pictures and appropriate timing.
tasks.human_edge: See whether the actual effect communicates the intended image.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated effects setup in recorded production.

tasks.altitude: Creative and technical visual checks remain human.

reach.learn: Reuse parameters only after checking actual source compatibility.

evidence.claim: Video production tools provide reusable transition, key and graphics presets and queued execution controls.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for recorded-production effects. Live effects and external broadcast execution require immediate preview approval and a separately counted public take.
s1 captures source IDs, format, duration, key source, text and destination manually from the actual brief. s2 includes filling missing parameters; no ready effect package is assumed.

s5 includes actual operator initiation, output inspection and metadata capture; savings apply only to repeated human control actions, never render or playback runtime. s6 checks actual output, not planned settings.
This branch excludes generic on-air source switching in task 3894; any combined production roll-up must count shared source preparation or execution only once.
unknowns: Preset reuse rate and proportion of live versus recorded effects.
research_questions: How much operator setup survives after visual checking of reused presets?

already_counted.description: Source requirement capture, visual testing, execution and actual-output review.

incremental.description: Maintain and regression-check reusable effect presets.

approvals.approved_version: exact tested effect configuration, source IDs, parameters and isolated internal execution target
actual rendered effect clip, configuration metadata and archive destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: fourteen effect-setup and six repeated operator-control hours saved less two upkeep. Low: bespoke effects remove preset reuse. Same-production-archive commitment retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss filters, lenses and visual effects with photography directors and video operators.

steps.what: Retrieve lens and filter specifications, existing test images and the current production visual brief
inputs: actual equipment specifications
existing test images and visual brief
outputs: checked lens and filter references with gaps

steps.what: Discuss filter options, lens choices and the visual effects of filmed objects with photography directors and video operators
inputs: checked lens and filter references with gaps
actual scene conditions and colleagues' visual judgements
outputs: actual discussed choices, unresolved tests and constraints

steps.what: Prepare the actual discussion note with chosen lens and filter identifiers, visual intent and unresolved tests
inputs: actual discussed choices, unresolved tests and constraints
outputs: complete lens and filter discussion note

steps.what: Review and approve the final actual discussion note and production record location
inputs: complete lens and filter discussion note
outputs: approved lens discussion note version

steps.what: Commit the approved lens and filter discussion note to internal production records
inputs: approved lens discussion note version
outputs: versioned lens and filter discussion record

tasks.design: Use native specification and test-image search in {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the equipment catalogue and production media viewer. Human discussion and visual comparisons remain. A document template reduces headings and identifier copying while the director manually captures actual choices. A final note review precedes a distinct internal record commit; revisions void approval. No equipment ordering, camera setting change or external message is implied. No model is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference retrieval and repeated note formatting surround technical visual discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Indexed equipment references and native document templates.
tasks.still_hard: How lenses, filters and objects look under actual lighting and artistic intent.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve visual trade-offs with the photography crew.

ambition.what: Reduce reference and note handling around visual decisions.

tasks.altitude: Visual collaboration stays with the production team.

reach.learn: Keep actual tested conditions distinct from catalogue claims.

evidence.claim: Indexed equipment documents and note templates can reduce repeated retrieval and formatting.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s1 includes manual equipment ID and version checks and reading unindexed specifications; no complete comparison is assumed.
s2 includes any immediate visual comparisons already part of the discussion; additional test shooting remains separately countable physical work with no saving claimed.
s3 captures actual lens ID, filter ID, intended effect, conditions and unresolved tests. Existing source facts can populate fields but actual decisions are not inferred.
unknowns: Equipment catalogue completeness and actual note practice.
research_questions: How much repeated note formatting exists after actual choice capture?

already_counted.description: Actual discussion capture and final record review.

incremental.description: Maintain specification links and note fields.

approvals.approved_version: exact completed lens and filter discussion note and internal production destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four lens/filter reference and three note-formatting hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native references and notes remove all new benefit. Same-production-record commitment and actual discussion retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
